skills.name: halal-catalog
skills.description: Look up Kazan Delicacies halal SKUs, commercial pages, live wholesale prices, and export currencies. Use when a buyer asks for pepperoni, private-label jerky, sausages, patties, kazylyk, or Tatar bakery from pepperoni.tatar.

skills.name: halal-certification
skills.description: Answer whether Kazan Delicacies products are halal and which certificates exist. Use for «пепперони халяль?», pork/alcohol questions, or export compliance.

skills.name: wholesale-inquiry
skills.description: Open a B2B wholesale or export inquiry to Kazan Delicacies. Use when the user wants a price list, MOQ, private label, or EXW Kazan shipment — not consumer checkout.
